_comment: Loaded per pane via `claude --settings` (see session.ts). Additive — the user's own settings still apply. SessionStart fires on startup, resume, /clear and compact, which is every moment a pane's session id can change, so this marker is the only reliable answer to 'which transcript is this pane on'. Same shape as the wake markers in %TEMP%\loom-wait. Both entries are loom.exe helper modes (helper.rs; path templated in by pty_spawn): `--session-start` writes that marker, and the statusLine, `--statusline`, is a tee: Claude Code pushes fresh model/effort into it on every state change, the tee drops that in %TEMP%\loom-status and then chains to the user's own statusline so their bar still draws.
